sets.p: Here is a photograph. It shows people cooking. Please tell us what you can see in the photograph.

sets.m: In this photo I can see two chefs in a kitchen. They are cooking. The man on the left is holding a pan, and there is some soup and a salad on the table. Maybe it is a restaurant kitchen. They look busy, but I think they are happy because they like cooking.

sets.m: This photo shows a family on a beach. There is a man, a woman and a girl. They are sitting near a big umbrella, and the girl is playing with a ball. I can see a boat on the sea. The weather looks hot and sunny. I think they are relaxing and enjoying their holiday.

sets.p: Here are your photographs. They show people studying in different places. Compare the photographs, and say what the advantages of studying in each place might be.
sets.pv: Hai ảnh: người học ở hai nơi khác nhau. So sánh hai ảnh và nói lợi ích của việc học ở mỗi nơi.
c: So sánh hai ảnh (both, whereas…)
Ảnh A: thư viện
Ảnh B: học trực tuyến ở nhà
Lợi ích của mỗi nơi
sets.m: Both photos show people studying, but in very different places. In the first photo, a student is working in a library, surrounded by books, whereas in the second one a young man is studying online at home on his laptop. The advantage of the library is that it's quiet, so it's easier to concentrate, and you can find all the books you need. On the other hand, studying at home is more comfortable and flexible, because you can choose when to work. Personally, I'd prefer the library before exams.

sets.p: Here are your photographs. They show people travelling in different ways. Compare the photographs, and say why the people might have chosen to travel in these ways.
sets.pv: Hai ảnh: người đi lại bằng hai cách. So sánh và nói vì sao họ có thể chọn cách đi đó.
c: So sánh hai ảnh
Ảnh A: đi tàu
Ảnh B: đi ô tô, kẹt xe
Lý do chọn cách đi (might, probably…)
sets.m: Both photos show people travelling, but in different ways. In the first one, a man is waiting for a train, while in the second photo there are lots of cars in heavy traffic. The man might have chosen the train because it's faster and he can relax or check his phone. On the other hand, the people driving probably need their cars because it's more convenient. Perhaps they have children or heavy bags. However, they look quite stressed in the traffic.

sets.p: Look at the photographs. They show people working in different situations. Compare two of the pictures and say what pressures the people might be under, and how they might be feeling.
sets.pv: Ba ảnh: người làm việc trong các hoàn cảnh khác nhau. Chọn 2 ảnh, so sánh, nói họ có thể chịu áp lực gì và cảm thấy thế nào.
c: Chọn 2 ảnh, so sánh
Áp lực có thể có
Cảm xúc có thể có
Từ suy đoán (might, could, I imagine…)
sets.m: I'm going to compare the office meeting and the construction site. In the first picture, the people seem to be under pressure to meet a deadline, and they might be feeling quite stressed, whereas the builder probably faces a different kind of pressure, which is safety, because the work could be dangerous. On the other hand, the people in the meeting can at least share the responsibility, while the builder may feel exhausted after a long day outdoors. I imagine both jobs are tiring in their own way.

sets.p: Look at the photographs. They show people doing physical activities. Compare two of the pictures and say why the people might have chosen these activities, and how beneficial they might be.
sets.pv: Ba ảnh: người tập thể dục. Chọn 2 ảnh, so sánh, nói vì sao họ chọn hoạt động đó và có lợi thế nào.
c: Chọn 2 ảnh, so sánh
Lý do chọn hoạt động
Lợi ích cho sức khoẻ, tinh thần
Từ suy đoán
sets.m: I'd like to compare the cyclists and the swimmers. The people cycling in the city might have chosen it because it's a convenient way to get to work and keep fit at the same time, whereas the swimmers are probably doing it to relax and reduce stress. Swimming is very healthy because it exercises the whole body, while cycling in traffic could be less beneficial if the air is polluted. On the other hand, both activities are good for your fitness, and I imagine they help people feel more energetic.

opts: What I had not expected was how much there was to learn before we could go anywhere. Knots, the names of every rope, the rules about which boat gives way to which: the theory seemed endless, and in the evenings I sat in the hotel bar with a book of diagrams, testing myself like a schoolboy before an exam.

The equipment, I soon discovered, was surprisingly expensive. A good waterproof jacket alone cost more than I had spent on clothes all year, and I spent several evenings comparing prices online before buying anything.

I passed the course, though not with distinction. More importantly, I have kept going. Every month or so I hire a dinghy at the local lake, and next summer I plan to join a club that races on the coast.

The course began on a grey Monday morning in April. There were six of us, ranging from a retired teacher to a nineteen-year-old student, and our instructor, a quiet woman called Jen, wasted no time. Within an hour we were out on the water in a small dinghy, and within two hours I had fallen in.

Not everything went smoothly, of course. On the way back, we misjudged a turn and drifted towards a line of moored yachts. A man on one of them shouted something I am glad I could not hear, and it took both of us, pulling with all our strength, to bring the boat round in time.
why: “That first soaking” chỉ về việc vừa ngã xuống nước ở đoạn D (fallen in); D cũng giới thiệu Jen và người thầy giáo về hưu nhắc ở sau.
“All that study” nối với việc học lý thuyết, xem sơ đồ ở đoạn A.
“that moment” = lúc suýt đâm vào thuyền neo ở đoạn E.
Đoạn C (đã qua khoá học, vẫn tiếp tục) dẫn tới câu kết “not too late to start something new”.

opts: The distinction, then, is between boredom as a passing state and boredom as a condition. The former may be productive; the latter is a sign that something in a person's life needs to change, and it is unlikely to be cured by a better app.

Alarms, however, are only useful if we respond to them in the right way. The difficulty with smartphones is not simply that they distract us, but that they silence the signal before it has done its work. A moment of tedium that might once have led to daydreaming, and from there to a new idea, is now ended within seconds.
The word itself is relatively young. 'Boredom' does not seem to have been widely used in English until the nineteenth century, although the state it describes is presumably as old as humanity.

For children in particular, this may be a skill worth learning early. A child who is never allowed to be bored never discovers what he or she might do about it, and the capacity to entertain oneself is one that tends to last a lifetime.

The most widely cited evidence comes from experiments in which participants were first given a deliberately tedious task, such as copying numbers from a telephone directory, and then asked to think of as many uses as possible for a pair of plastic cups. Those who had endured the dull task came up with more original ideas than those who had gone straight to the creative exercise.
why: “this effect” cần một kết quả nghiên cứu: đoạn E (việc nhàm chán trước giúp nghĩ ra nhiều ý hơn).
“an alarm worth listening to” → đoạn B mở bằng “Alarms, however…”.
Sau đoạn nói buồn chán kéo dài có hại, đoạn A phân biệt trạng thái thoáng qua với tình trạng kéo dài; “What follows from this” chỉ về sự phân biệt đó.
Đoạn D (trẻ em) nối với “resist the urge to fill every empty moment” và kết bài.

items.txt:
SWIMMING POOL
Children under 8 must swim with an adult.
No food near the pool.
items.a: Young children need an adult with them in the pool.
w: Children under 8 cannot use the pool.
You can eat by the pool if you are careful.
items.why: "Children under 8 must swim with an adult": trẻ nhỏ vẫn bơi được nhưng phải có người lớn đi cùng; không được ăn gần bể.

items.txt: Mum, I've taken the dog for a walk in the park. Back at 5. Can you buy some milk on your way home? Tom
items.a: Tom wants his mum to get some milk.
w: Tom is buying milk at the shop now.
Tom has left the dog at home.
items.why: "Can you buy some milk on your way home?": Tom nhờ mẹ mua sữa; Tom đang dắt chó đi dạo.

items.txt:
LIBRARY
Books must be returned by Friday.
Late books: 50p a day.
items.a: You pay money if you return a book after Friday.
w: The library is closed on Fridays.
You can borrow books for 50p.
items.why: "Late books: 50p a day": trả sách muộn mỗi ngày mất 50 xu.

items.txt: Hi Anna, The football match tomorrow is at 3 pm, not 2 pm. Can you tell the others? Meet at the bus stop at 2.30. Jack
items.a: Jack wants Anna to tell other people about the new time.
w: The football match has been cancelled.
They will meet at the football ground at 2.30.
items.why: "Can you tell the others?": Jack nhờ Anna báo cho mọi người; trận đấu đổi giờ chứ không huỷ; điểm hẹn là trạm xe buýt.

items.txt:
SCHOOL TRIP TO THE ZOO
Bring a packed lunch and a drink.
The bus leaves at 8.15 sharp.
items.a: Students must take their own food.
w: Lunch will be bought at the zoo.
The bus will wait for late students.
items.why: "Bring a packed lunch": tự mang đồ ăn; "8.15 sharp" = đúng 8 giờ 15, xe không chờ.

items.txt:
TOMATO SOUP
Heat for 3 minutes. Do not boil.
Keep in the fridge after opening.
items.a: After you open it, you should put it in the fridge.
w: You must boil the soup for 3 minutes.
You do not need to heat the soup.
items.why: "Keep in the fridge after opening": mở ra rồi thì cất tủ lạnh; hâm 3 phút nhưng không đun sôi.

items.txt:
CAFÉ
Today only: buy one cake, get a second cake free!
items.a: You can get two cakes for the price of one today.
w: All cakes are free today.
The café is closed today.
items.why: "buy one cake, get a second cake free": mua một tặng một, chỉ hôm nay.

items.txt: Lucy, Your piano lesson is on Thursday this week, not Wednesday. The teacher is ill on Wednesday. Mum
items.a: Lucy's piano lesson is on a different day this week.
w: Lucy's piano teacher is ill on Thursday.
Lucy has two piano lessons this week.
items.why: Buổi học dời sang thứ Năm vì thứ Tư cô giáo ốm.

items.txt:
PLEASE KEEP THIS DOOR CLOSED
The cat must not go outside.
items.a: You should close the door so the cat stays in.
w: The cat likes to sleep by the door.
You must not use this door.
items.why: Đóng cửa để mèo không ra ngoài; cửa vẫn dùng được.

items.txt: Hi Sam, I can't come to your party on Saturday because I'm visiting my grandparents. Can we meet on Sunday instead? Kate
items.a: Kate wants to see Sam on a different day.
w: Kate's grandparents are coming to Sam's party.
Kate is having a party on Sunday.
items.why: "Can we meet on Sunday instead?": Kate muốn gặp Sam vào ngày khác.

items.txt:
SPORTS CENTRE
The swimming pool will be closed all next week for cleaning. The gym is open as usual.
items.a: You can use the gym next week.
w: The sports centre is closed next week.
The pool is being cleaned this week.
items.why: Chỉ bể bơi đóng cửa, và là tuần sau; phòng tập vẫn mở.

items.txt:
BIKE FOR SALE
Blue, 2 years old, good condition. £60 or nearest offer. Call Ben after 6 pm.
items.a: Ben might sell the bike for a bit less than £60.
w: The bike is new.
You should call Ben in the morning.
items.why: "or nearest offer" = có thể bán rẻ hơn một chút; xe đã 2 năm; gọi sau 6 giờ tối.

items.txt:
TENNIS CLUB MEMBERS
Courts can be booked up to three days in advance at reception. Bookings made by phone must be confirmed in person on the day.
items.a: If you book a court by phone, you have to go to reception to confirm it.
w: Members can only book courts on the day they want to play.
Phone bookings are not accepted by the club.
items.why: "must be confirmed in person on the day": đặt qua điện thoại được, nhưng phải đến xác nhận trực tiếp; đặt trước tối đa 3 ngày.

items.txt: Hi Maria, The concert starts at 7.30, but the doors open at 6.45. If we want seats near the front, we should get there early. Shall we meet at the café opposite at 6.15? Leo
items.a: Leo suggests meeting before the doors open.
w: Leo has already bought seats at the front.
The concert begins at 6.45.
items.why: Gặp lúc 6.15, trước khi cửa mở lúc 6.45; buổi hoà nhạc bắt đầu 7.30.

items.txt:
STUDENT KITCHEN
Please wash and put away your own dishes. Anything left in the sink after 10 pm will be thrown away.
items.a: Dishes left in the sink late at night will be removed.
w: The kitchen closes at 10 pm.
Cleaners will wash all the dishes after 10 pm.
items.why: "will be thrown away" = bị bỏ đi; bếp không đóng lúc 10 giờ, cũng không có ai rửa giúp.

items.txt: Dad, the plumber phoned. He can't come tomorrow morning, but he could come on Friday afternoon. Can you call him back to say if that's OK? Emma
items.a: Emma wants her dad to agree a new time with the plumber.
w: The plumber will definitely come on Friday afternoon.
Emma has already arranged a time with the plumber.
items.why: Thợ đề nghị chiều thứ Sáu nhưng chưa chốt; Emma nhờ bố gọi lại xác nhận.

items.txt:
SUMMER JOBS
City Museum needs friendly, reliable assistants for July and August. No experience needed – full training given. Must be available at weekends.
items.a: People without experience can apply for these jobs.
w: The jobs are only at weekends.
Applicants must have worked in a museum before.
items.why: "No experience needed – full training given": chưa có kinh nghiệm vẫn nộp được; cần rảnh cuối tuần nhưng việc không chỉ có cuối tuần.

items.txt:
LIBRARY
From 1 March, the library will open at 9 am instead of 10 am on weekdays. Weekend opening hours will not change.
items.a: The library will open earlier on weekdays from March.
w: The library will close earlier at weekends.
The library is now open at 9 am every day.
items.why: Chỉ ngày thường mở sớm hơn (9 giờ thay vì 10 giờ), từ 1/3; cuối tuần giữ nguyên.

items.txt: Hi Chris, Thanks for lending me your camera. I'm afraid I dropped it on the beach and now the screen doesn't work. I'll pay to get it repaired, of course. Sorry! Alex
items.a: Alex is offering to pay for the damage.
w: Alex wants to borrow Chris's camera again.
The camera stopped working before Alex borrowed it.
items.why: "I'll pay to get it repaired": Alex trả tiền sửa; máy hỏng vì Alex làm rơi.

items.txt:
CAR PARK
Free for the first two hours. After that, £2 per hour. Pay at the machine before returning to your car.
items.a: You only have to pay if you stay more than two hours.
w: Parking costs £2 for the first two hours.
You pay when you drive out of the car park.
items.why: Hai giờ đầu miễn phí; trả ở máy trước khi quay lại xe, không phải lúc lái ra.

items.txt: Jo – I've gone to the station to meet Grandma. Her train is late, so I don't know when we'll be back. There's pasta in the fridge if you're hungry. Mum
items.a: Jo's mum is not sure what time she will return.
w: Grandma's train arrived early.
Mum has cooked dinner and left it on the table.
items.why: "I don't know when we'll be back": mẹ chưa biết mấy giờ về; tàu đến muộn; mì để trong tủ lạnh.

items.txt:
PHOTOGRAPHY COMPETITION
Open to students aged 14–18. Send one photo only, taken this year, by 30 April. The winner's photo will appear in the school magazine.
items.a: Each student can enter one photo that was taken this year.
w: Students can send as many photos as they like.
All the photos will be printed in the magazine.
items.why: "Send one photo only, taken this year": mỗi người một ảnh chụp năm nay; chỉ ảnh thắng giải được in.
